description: This file implements a class for demangling C++ symbol names, with platform-specific handling for Linux and Windows, and utility functions for extracting class names and file names, as well as logging messages.

classes.name: Demangling
classes.description: A utility class for demangling C++ symbol names, with platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows, and thread safety.

methods.name: Demangled
methods.description: Demangles a given symbol name into a human-readable form, platform-specific handling for Linux and Windows.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Extracts the class name from a demangled symbol name.

methods.name: ClassNameOnly
methods.description: Utility function to get class name only from a symbol name.

methods.name: FileNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a full file path.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted log message string with filename, line number, and message.
